title: Swap your way to order
hints: `swap_ints` receives two addresses. Read the values with `*a` and `*b`, and write through them the same way. Park one value in a local `int` first.
Three compare-and-swaps sort three values: first make `*a <= *b`, then `*b <= *c` (now the largest is in `*c`), then `*a <= *b` once more.
`void swap_ints(int *a, int *b) { int t = *a; *a = *b; *b = t; }` and in `sort_three`: `if (*a > *b) swap_ints(a, b); if (*b > *c) swap_ints(b, c); if (*a > *b) swap_ints(a, b);`
